Site wardens

Two wardens walk the site every evening in summer and lock the gates when the last member has left. They are members like you, and they give their time for nothing. If you see something that is not right on the site, tell one of them, or leave a note in the box on the door of the hut.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
